infrastructure_gaps.detail: DomainState::from_env(pool_max) requires FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID, Firebase Admin credentials and MARKETPLACE_DATABASE_URL, builds FirestoreRest + FirebaseJwksVerifier, and never falls back to MemoryFirestore. require_durable_firestore() returns 503 on the test store.
The external crate is a library mounted inside the root API; the CDN/edge worker (workers/pokoin-origin.js and CDN HTTP edge migration) is out of this crate's ownership and not migrated here.

CardTrader seller reconcile is a native tokio task with an in-process + Redis lock (cardtrader::async_sync, tested). Global daily-listings refresh, sales backfill and reconcile-all scheduled jobs remain on the Node host script and are not ported.

src/firebase.rs implements JWKS RS256 ID-token verification, Firestore REST (get/merge/create/delete/merge_if) and an in-memory fake; FirestoreStore::durable() is false for the fake, and DomainState::from_env refuses to build production state without FIREBASE_* + MARKETPLACE_DATABASE_URL, so MemoryFirestore can never answer a production success.

crates/external/Cargo.toml pins direct dependency versions and declares its own [workspace] root (with workspace.package fields) so it compiles independently of the root workspace; the integrator removes that block when adding the crate to pokoin-rust members.
